subject: 藏地跨年代地域素材：河岸装卸小石埠（原创扩展；具体城市年代适用待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. One compact broad stone river landing for a Tibetan old-town strategy game sprite, true transparent RGBA. The whole platform is a rectangular plane of EIGHT by FOUR equally sized roughly square stone slabs: eight slabs along its long edge and four slabs along its short edge. Thus its true plan aspect ratio is exactly2:1, NOT a narrow strip. Orthographic dimetric camera45degrees yaw30degrees elevation, screen ground vectors slope+0.5 and-0.5. Front left edge from LEFT(160,420) to FRONT(960,820), right edge from FRONT(960,820) to RIGHT(1360,620), rear corner(560,220) within1536x1024; keep the complete silhouette inside clear margins. Frontage horizontal span800, depth span400. Low platform only two thin courses of irregular masonry, rough worn flat paving stones, a shallow recessed step at near edge, one short weathered wooden mooring post near right end, two small tied unlabelled sacks and a small timber crate near rear corner. Goods do not obscure perimeter corners. Restrained realistic antique stone/wood rendering, detailed rough textures, muted cream tan and gray weathered materials. Upper-left sunlight, right-side short contact shadow. No water, no boat, no floor or terrain outside rectangular platform, no background, no vegetation, no buildings, no people, no text or markings. Opaque alpha255 object, alpha0 background, no semitransparent ambient halo. Platform must look BROAD and short, with precisely twice as many slabs along long side as short side.
negative: 无文字/现代物/人物/景观背景/厚地台；不拉伸、旋转、重绘或抠白底
created_time_basis: 工具PNG本地mtime，非服务端生成时间

geometry_qa.anchor_method: 人工可见墙脚L/F/R，后角按平行边推算；底面中心=(L+R)/2。非alpha底中点。

steps: alpha>1 determines bounding rectangle only; preserved all pixels inside rectangle
uniform LANCZOS resize with integer pixel rounding
paste without alpha mask onto transparent canvas; no repaint or warp

notes: 合入前审核返修：本轮2候选选第2；旧候选留档。原图及成品已view_image；仅裁切、等比缩放、透明扩边。占地未改，底角重新量取，实测残差见geometry_qa；不宣称全部几何通过，维持candidate。
